notes: Cross-verse split with ACT.2.11. Both verses have a Greek article governing a substantival adjective with no head noun expressed and a generic noun supplied by the ASV, and only ACT.2.11 applied rule 102. Rule 102 is explicit and reports the corpus unanimous - all fifty-three units of an article taking a determiner plus a nominal head on the nominal and none on *the*, and every unit finalized since rule 49 entered the contract reads the substantival-adjective shape the article's way, twelve to none - and it scopes rule 17's generic-noun clause to anarthrous Greek. So tei dexiai now gives the discontinuous *by the ... hand* to the article headed on *hand*, with the case preposition riding along under rule 21, and a bare *right* to the adjective, exactly as ta megaleia gives *the ... works* to its article at ACT.2.11. Only s001 and s002 change; the remaining twenty-two units are reproduced as the verse pass returned them.
